children: JEDDAH — The General Directorate of Traffic announced on Tuesday the establishment of six new driving schools across various regions and governorates of Saudi Arabia.
The directorate stated that one school each will be established in Asir, Jazan, Dammam Metropolitan Area, Hail, Makkah, and Al-Jouf.

Interested companies and institutions are invited to apply for this project by contacting the Traffic Licenses Department under the General Directorate of Traffic via email to receive the project's terms and conditions.
They need to submit their request within one month of this announcement.
